root_visual_review.layout: Both regular/disordered rows and all five receiver categories visible; four methods and denominator regularizers labeled, zero and large errors not clipped. Footer distinguishes this coarse static crop from a Cryer trajectory and records the missing native-exit evidence.
root_visual_review.interpretation: Linear-field arithmetic is correct but quadratic exactness is not established. In the regular coarse sphere/Eta2/real-symC example, isotropic relative errors are about1.036percent at the center,6.26-6.50percent at the three axial receivers and36.46percent near the curved cutoff. These are manufactured scalar truncation errors at dp=.01/R=.06, NOT actual Cryer pressure errors or a physical acceptance gate.

coefficient_identity: For the complete-support regular/Eta0/common-C control, the isotropic quadratic response is6=3alpha at alpha2. Replacing coefficient2 by3 would produce9, not6. Keep coefficient2; varying-C, Eta2 and truncated-support cases are not required to satisfy this conditional identity.

runtime_record_gap.reason: The silent standalone program produced the seven complete files, but the wrapper tried to hash a nonexistent empty stdout log before serializing the native exit. The new offline pass does not recreate that missing receipt or alter the old failure.
